page.overview:
Who is Assault Star?

Assault Star is an Autobot who appears in the game Transformers: Online. She has a great distaste for those who would rely solely on brute force; to her, the only things worth commending are skill and speed. While an extremist opinion, it has gained her numerous victories in the war. Category:Characters Category:Cybertronian
